title: 2027 Planner Printable, Weekly Planner PDF, Goal Planner with Reset Kit, Habit Tracker, A4 and Letter, Monday or Sunday Start
description:
You buy a planner in January, miss two weeks in February, and the blank pages make it feel too late to start again.
This one is built for that week. Each week has The Calm Line: three priorities at most, and a "Not this week" list for everything else. When you miss weeks, the Comeback page tells you to skip the gaps and start at today's week.

WHAT'S INSIDE (99 pages, dated Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2027)
• 2027 Reset Kit: a look back at 2026, a theme word and vision board, three goals at most, a not-this-year list, and a habit builder with a 3-habit cap
• 4 × 90-day plans
• 12 month calendars + 12 monthly Calm Reset pages (a habit grid with a comebacks counter instead of streaks)
• 53 weekly pages with The Calm Line and a 1-minute Calm Check (Light / Steady / Full, plus one suggested move)
• No catch-up Comeback page, a "Next 3 things" home page, Ask AI prompt cards
• Extras: the 2027 Calm Tracker spreadsheet (Excel + Google Sheets, 4 colour themes, Lock-In Score 0–100, a "protect today" habit, a comebacks counter, Ask AI prompts built from your own numbers), a reminders .ics file (52 Sunday reviews, 12 monthly resets, 4 quarterly plans), 2 phone wallpapers, and a printable gift card

FILES (5 downloads)
Letter-Monday, Letter-Sunday, A4-Monday and A4-Sunday zips. Each one holds a Colour PDF and an Ink-saver PDF. The Extras zip holds the tracker, the .ics, the wallpapers, the gift card and the Quick-Start guide.

HOW TO USE
1. Download on a computer and unzip. 2. Print all of it, or only the months you need, at 100% / actual size. 3. Import the .ics into Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar if you want the Sunday reminders. 4. Open the tracker in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets (steps in the Quick-Start guide).

GOOD TO KNOW
• This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped. Printing is not included.
• Designed by Steadfold with AI assistance: the pages were built in code with Claude, then checked page by page. The Ask AI cards are optional text prompts you can paste into any assistant you choose.
• The listing images show the real pages, rendered from the files you download (a few have sample handwriting added to show the pages in use).
• Google Sheets needs a free Google account. Printed colours vary by printer.
• For personal use only. Questions? Message the shop any time.
• Launch sale: 25% off until 30 Nov 2026. Regular price US$16.
